title: Register as a training organisation before providing VET courses
what: A person must be an NVR registered training organisation to provide, or offer to provide, all or part of a VET course in a referring state or a territory.

laws.title: National Vocational Education and Training Regulator Act 2011

sources.title: National Vocational Education and Training Regulator Act 2011
sources.quote: 116 Offence—providing, or offering to provide, all or part of a VET course without registration (1) A person commits an offence if: (a) the person provides, or offers to provide, all or part of a VET course in a referring State or a Territory; and (b) the person is not an NVR registered training organisation.
